no_twins.what: no register twins: no task is also posed with X and Y swapped (lt~, modx~, ..., reduce~)

no_routines.what: routines off: a solved task's program never becomes a routine T.<task>; the round's search composes the library's merges instead of routines

no_redstep.what: the two step-definition laws (red.step) dropped: no modB (the chain) and no step practice problems; reduce waits for add only

no_step.what: the step practice problem dropped (red.step's step law); modB kept

no_modB.what: the chain practice problem dropped (red.step's ladder); step kept, its target computed by B conditional subtractions (modx) instead of the chain

no_mrow.what: the multiply row practice problem dropped (mul.ladder's row); mac's target computes the row by repeated addition instead of the mrow helper

no_brg.what: BRG.X (bring X's top digit into A) removed from every search's primitives

no_sel.what: SEL.S (keep or discard on the borrow) removed from every search's primitives

ans_smallest_t.what: the round's answers: the batch's smallest-T rows (answer_rows) whatever their T, no T = 1 filter

no_sel_wide.what: no_sel (SEL.S (keep or discard on the borrow) removed from every search's primitives), and a wider search for modx, modx~: its library searches store up to 60,000,000 states per level (every program up to cost 6) with no time limit of their own
